   MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  NORWALK COMMUNITY PROMOTION COMMISSION
  APRIL 14, 2025

Vice Chair Ang called the meeting to order at 6:00 p.m. Responding to roll call were Commissioner
Garcia and Commissioner Sanchez. Chair Leon was absent. Also present was Levy Sun, Director of
Communications and Public Affairs, Alex Ocegueda, Office Assistant III and Jocelyn Hernandez,
Communications Specialist.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Commissioner Sanchez made the motion and Vice Chair Ang seconded to approve the minutes for
March 10, 2025. There being no objection, the motion carried.

REPORTS

Community Promotion Commission Orientation

Mr. Sun provided an orientation about the expectations of the commission and staff. Mrs. Ocegueda
provided commissioners with an updated 2025 Commission Schedule sheet.

Home & Business Beautification Contest

Mrs. Ocegueda provided a PowerPoint presentation and rating sheets for the entries received for the
contest. Commissioners reviewed the entries and returned the rating sheets to Mrs. Ocegueda. An
update on winners will be provided at the next meeting.

Meet & Greet Dinner

Mrs. Ocegueda provided the invitation flyer for review and approval. Commissioner Sanchez asked to
add “Hawaiian Attire Encouraged” on the invitation. Mrs. Ocegueda explained this year she will be
asking staff liaisons to help obtain RSVPs from their commissioners. Mrs. Ocegueda requested
clarification on how many people to consider for the food budget. The direction received was to
calculate for 60 and 80 people. Mrs. Ocegueda presented items and pricing to review for party favors
based on their recommendations. Commissioner Sanchez asked regarding other items such as cups
and pens. Mrs. Ocegueda clarified that those items had high minimums for purchasing; the items being
presented allowed for a minimum of 50 units. Commissioner Garcia asked what would go on the custom
items. Mrs. Ocegueda confirmed that it will have the city logo with the text “Commissioner Appreciation
2025”. Commissioners placed their votes on their preferred party favor item and Mrs. Ocegueda will
reach out to Chair Leon for her input.

Business Spotlight

Mr. Sun showed the “Keeping It Norwalk” Campaign, the March Best Carwash Spots edition video to
Commissioners. Mrs. Ocegueda stated staff will be out next week to film for the next spotlight theme.
 Minutes of the Regular Meeting
Community Promotion Commission
April 14, 2025

Communications and Public Affairs Analytics

Mr. Sun provided the analytics and explained Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and the city’s overall
reach across all outreach platforms for the last month showing an increase in key metrics.
Commissioner Garcia asked if the city had a TikTok account. Mr. Sun explained it did not due the
archiving rules/regulations the city must maintain for public records.

STAFF COMMENTS:

Mrs. Ocegueda confirmed that ninety-five (95) responses were received for their city merchandise
survey efforts at the Artastic event. Mr. Sun stated that the Commission would need to obtain a
minimum of 600 responses before they can start acquiring merchandise. Mrs. Ocegueda stated she
will confirm the dates for the Fourth of July, Summer Concerts, and Front Street Friday events from
Recreation for further survey efforts. Commissioners would like the survey QR code in the June edition
of the Norwalk Now and will use copies of the Norwalk Now at the Commissioners Appreciation Dinner
to get commissioners input for the survey.

COMMISSIONERS COMMENTS:

Vice Chair Ang asked if the future list of themes for the Business Spotlight include “Family Fun Venues”.
Mrs. Ocegueda stated that she will bring the discussion of Business Spotlight themes to the
commission’s July meeting. Commissioner Sanchez welcomed Commissioner Garcia and stated he
attended the Mayor’s Prayer Breakfast event. Commissioner Garcia reported he was happy to be a
part of the commission and looks forward to contributing to their future success.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

No Oral Communication

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:30 p.m.

_____________________________

David Ang, Vice Chair
Community Promotion Commission
